text: For a sustained attendance decline, propose a private student conversation and an agreed follow-up date. Staff must review the student context before acting.
For outstanding fees or a financial help request, propose a financial aid appointment. Verify eligibility against an approved institutional scholarship policy; do not promise an award.
For falling marks or growing backlogs, propose subject-specific academic support and a two-week progress review. External or guardian contact requires staff approval and applicable student consent.
